mapper.insert: INSERT INTO credential_rotation_log (id, operator, status, rotated_count, skipped_count, error_message, started_at, finished_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{operator}, #{status}, #{rotatedCount}, #{skippedCount}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE credential_rotation_log SET status = #{status}, rotated_count = #{rotatedCount}, skipped_count = #{skippedCount}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, operator, status, rotated_count AS rotatedCount, skipped_count AS skippedCount, error_message AS errorMessage, started_at AS startedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt FROM credential_rotation_log ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
